titles.title: Dead Tree with Pink Hill

description: A bare gray and brown tree rises through the center of the landscape. The tree stands on sloping pale pink earth covered in light green bushes. Behind the tree are rolling pink hills dotted with dark green piñon trees. A bright blue sky arches overhead.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Cleveland Museum of Art.
title: Dead Tree with Pink Hill
